title: Spätzle with Tagine-Style Tofu
description: A German-inspired vegetarian dish featuring crispy spätzle noodles topped with a flavorful tagine-style tofu, a North African twist.
instructions: Mix together flour, egg, and a pinch of salt to form spätzle dough.
Pipe dough into boiling water, 2-3 minutes.
Remove spätzle with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Crumble tofu into small pieces and cook in a skillet with vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add vegetable broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toss spätzle with a pinch of salt and serve with tagine-style tofu.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
